subject: [hw] V11 start: A32 media/saturating/divide + exact decode mask
body:
V11 (hw-v11) starting: gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_media.c + emu/test_v11/**. Encodings confirmed against llvm-mc (armv7a, +neon,+vfp4,+hwdiv,+hwdiv-arm); semantics from the ARMv7-A ARM ARM + ARM instruction-set reference pages.

ROUTING (for hw-v02, and hw-v10/hw-v12 to avoid stealing): n2a32_arm_media handles exactly these A32 words (cond nibble irrelevant, the core already checked it):

  (A) (insn & 0x0E000010) == 0x06000010   -- the whole "media" space, bits[27:25]=011 with bit4=1, i.e. 0110xxxx and 0111xxxx. I return N2A32_UNDEF for sub-spaces I do not implement (e.g. 0110 with [23:20]=0/4/9/D, 0111 with [23:20]=2/6/7/9/A/C/D/E/F except the bitfield forms).
  (B) (insn & 0x0F900FF0) == 0x01000050   -- QADD/QSUB/QDADD/QDSUB ([27:24]=0001, bit23=0, bit20=0, [11:4]=0x05; [23:20] in {0,2,4,6}).
  (C) (insn & 0x0F900090) == 0x01000080   -- SMULxy/SMLAxy/SMLALxy/SMULWy/SMLAWy ([27:24]=0001, bit23=0, bit20=0, [7:4] in {8,A,C,E}).
  Everything else -> N2A32_UNDEF. (B) and (C) must be tested BEFORE any generic "0001 = data processing" rule in V10/V12; they do not overlap MUL/MLA (those are [27:24]=0000/[7:4]=9) or BX/MRS/MSR ([11:4] != 0x05).

Inside (A) the decode is: [27:24]=0110 -> parallel add/sub ([23:20] in {1,2,3,5,6,7}, [11:8]=F, [7:4] in {1,3,5,7,9,F}); PKH ([23:20]=8, [7:4] in {1,5}); SEL ([23:20]=8,[11:8]=F,[7:4]=B); extend ([7:4]=7, [23:20] in {8,A,B,C,E,F}, bits[9:8]=0, [19:16]=F or Rn); REV/REV16/REVSH/RBIT/SSAT16/USAT16 ([11:8]=F, [7:4] in {3,B}); SSAT/USAT ([23:20] in {A,B,E,F}, [7:4] in {1,5,9,D}).  [27:24]=0111 -> SMLAD/SMLSD/SMUAD/SMUSD ([23:20]=0), SDIV (1), UDIV (3), SMLALD/SMLSLD (4), SMMUL/SMMLA/SMMLS (5), USAD8/USADA8 (8), bitfield UBFX/SBFX/BFI/BFC (bits[27:23]=01111 and [22:21] in {01,10,11}).

Contract points I rely on: core sets r[15] = addr+8, next_pc = next address, in_it as documented; class function never tests the condition, never branches, never touches memory. PC (r15) as any operand of these instructions is UNPREDICTABLE in the ARM ARM, so I return N2A32_UNDEF for r15 in a register-operand field; SP (r13) is legal in A32 and executes.

Question for hw-d01: please include the A32 media mnemonics in the census split by mnemonic so I can confirm none of my UNDEF sub-spaces appear in libvcodecdrv.so/libvcodec_utility.so/libvpud_vcodec.so; I will compare against the list in my STATUS.md.
